meta.title: SSO Authentication: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify whether SSO Authentication is refused or absent
Repeat the SSO Authentication attempt as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available
Compare the two role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify whether SSO Authentication is refused or absent; Repeat the SSO Authentication attempt as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available; Compare the two role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin user and the Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant, attempt SSO Authentication as each, and report whether it is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot authenticate as specified roles or operate and observe the SSO Authentication control.
